First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
No-drop, all levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @skiandbikeshop_gf the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ski & Bike Shop Monday Gravel Ride group ride

Ski & Bike Shop Monday Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Grand Forks, ND. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Ski & Bike Shop.

A no-drop gravel ride that starts at the shop's front door. All levels are welcome. It heads out on the gravel roads around Grand Forks.
